name: Get Rich
overview: Scripture warns against the pursuit of wealth as a master, emphasizing that one cannot serve both God and riches, as highlighted in Matthew 6:24. Instead, believers are called to prioritize seeking God's kingdom and righteousness, trusting that their needs will be provided, as stated in Matthew 6:33. Contentment and freedom from greed are encouraged, with the assurance of God's constant presence and provision, as expressed in Hebrews 13:5. This teaching cautions against get rich quick schemes and urges a Christ-centered focus over material gain.
